name: braille-dual-render
title: Braille Dual Render
description: Renders a phrase in both Latin type and Unicode braille side by side, with per-cell dot animation on value change and real screen-reader behaviour (Latin spoken, braille aria-hidden decoration).
designRules:
# Design System

Genre: Technical
Macrostructure: Stack
Density: Medium
Shape: Rounded
Motion: Subtle
Typography: Monospace
Color: Monochrome

## Rules

- Value Sync: the interaction model is part of the design, not an add-on.
- Reduced motion replaces animation with a state change; nothing is hidden behind motion.
- The component composes through `cn` and never hardcodes colours.

## Avoid

- Reskinning this resource and republishing it under a new name.
- Adding shadows or radii that contradict its shape language.
